context_requirements: TNF receptor signaling competence for TNF-mediated effects
CYP2E1 expression and metabolic activation capacity for CYP2E1-dependent effects
proliferative signaling dependence for antiproliferative consequences
intact stress-response pathways (NF-kB, p53, ER stress) for transcriptional output
falsifiers: No consistent directional change in any of the listed proximal or late genes across responsive lines
Predominant upregulation of proliferation and cell-cycle genes rather than downregulation
Absence of any transcriptional response at 24 h in all nine lines
Strong interferon signature without other expected stress or antiproliferative changes

evidence.supports: Luteolin, a flavonoid anticancer agent, inhibits proliferation, induces cell cycle arrest and apoptosis, and increases ROS/ER stress in cancer cells.
KP1019, a ruthenium anticancer agent, induces apoptosis via the mitochondrial pathway and shows activity against various tumor types.
SAHA/vorinostat, an HDAC inhibitor anticancer agent, causes growth arrest and death of transformed cells and affects transcription factors controlling proliferation and death.
UCN-01, an anticancer kinase inhibitor, targets Chk1 and Cdc25C regulatory pathways and abrogates G2 checkpoint function.
ON01910, a Plk1 inhibitor anticancer agent, induces mitotic arrest, spindle abnormalities, and apoptosis in tumor cells.

changes: Removed duplicate stress genes (GADD45A, GADD45B, SQSTM1, TRIB3, DDIT4, ATF5) from late_up because they already appear in proximal_up; a gene must not appear in both an up and a down list of the same time, and these are early stress-response genes.

Removed generic proliferation/stress genes from proximal lists: cell-cycle genes (CCND1, CCND3, CCNE2, MYC, E2F2, TFDP1, CDC25A, CDC25B, CCNA2, AURKA, AURKB, PLK1, TOP2A, BIRC5, MCM3) are not immediate transcriptional targets of TNF or CYP2E1 and belong to generic proliferation_down effects.

Removed generic proliferation/stress genes from late lists: cell-cycle genes (CCNA2, CCNB1, CCNB2, CDK1, CDC20, BUB1B, KIF20A, KIF2C, NUSAP1, UBE2C, MYBL2, STMN1, PCNA) are generic proliferation_down effects, not specific late transcriptional outputs of TNF/CYP2E1.
Kept only evidence whose abstract supports the stated claim; all five cited abstracts describe anticancer agents with mechanisms consistent with the stated supports.
